verdict.rationale: Apple's own docs name Migration Assistant as the tool for setting up a new Mac, including when migrating from Windows, and point switchers to guidance on transferring files from a PC. That covers the file-transfer core, but the evidence never explicitly says settings are transferred. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that settings, accounts and apps migrate, details of the Migration Assistant transfer process and its limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can transfer my files and settings from my old computer to a new machine running the OS

citations.quote: With Migration Assistant, setting up a new Mac is still quick and easy — even if you’re migrating from Windows.
If you’re switching to Mac, start here to make it a smooth transition. Learn how to find your way around the Mac, how to transfer your files from your PC, and more.
